_comment: Sources for the AI Research Radar section. Deliberately NOT another generic AI newsletter — this feeds a Phase 1 triage pass (see prompts/phase1-triage.md relevance_lens field) that keeps only items matching one of Backbase's actual AI relevance lenses (relevance_lenses below). Read by the 'Load AI Research Sources' Code node.

relevance_lenses.description: Autonomous / agentic AI systems that take action (not just chat) in a financial-services or adjacent regulated context — directly Backbase's own 2026 thesis (AI-native Banking OS, 'Unified Frontline', Kasisto acquisition).

AI explainability, auditability, guardrails, or regulatory frameworks for AI decisioning — maps to Backbase's Sentinel/Authority Layer and Decision Token positioning; anything a regulator would ask about agentic AI in banking.

Model releases or capability jumps in tool-use, function-calling, long-context, or reasoning from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, Mistral, or similar — these directly change what Backbase (and Kasisto-derived capabilities) can build.

Protocols and standards for AI agents talking to systems/each other (e.g. Model Context Protocol and similar) — relevant to how Backbase's Banking OS integrates AI agents with core banking, CRM, and data platforms.
A named banking-software or CX-platform competitor (see competitor-watch.json) shipping or announcing an AI/agentic feature specifically.

AI-specific regulatory action (EU AI Act financial-services provisions, US banking-regulator guidance on AI/model risk, etc.) — distinct from general banking regulatory news already covered by the Regulatory sources in rss-sources.json.

general_ai_rss.name: VentureBeat — AI
general_ai_rss.notes: Sept 2026 audit: direct feed answers every request (UA and browser UA alike) with HTTP 429, immediately and consistently — a soft rate-limit wall, not transient throttling. Falls back to a Google News site:venturebeat.com query, verified 35 in-window items. This entry stores the already-built Google News URL directly (unlike the RSS registry's fetch.method split) because load-ai-research-sources.js treats every general_ai_rss entry as a direct fetch by design.

notes: general_ai_rss casts a deliberately wide net (mainstream tech-press AI coverage) precisely because Normalize AI Research Item's relevance-lens filter does the real narrowing before curation — this section should NOT become 'AI news in general.' If keep-rate for this branch drops below ~10%, narrow general_ai_rss further rather than loosening the relevance lenses. targeted_google_news_queries are higher-precision by construction and should dominate the section in most weeks. Every Google News query gets 'when:7d' appended at build time (see build-workflow.mjs) — do not bake it into the query strings here, so the window stays centrally controlled. Per-source 'cap' bounds how many in-window items one query can contribute; general_ai_rss feeds are capped lower than targeted queries because they are lower-precision by construction.
